_comment: Records are the passport's subjects — one product, one origin story. This file IS the passport data: no chain, no dashboard, no API key. `photo` is the documentary image used on the page (hands, cloth, looms); `image` is the record sheet drawn by `npm run record:svg`, used on the passport and for print. Prose fields (description, subtitle, attribute values) are Indonesian: the design system speaks Indonesian first and only glosses in English where a reader needs the word. The 'Journey step' attribute is the exception — its value must stay equal to a step label in lib/copy.ts (Seed, Loom, Trace, Teach, Regenerate, Hub, Flourish), because JourneyStrip matches on it to mark the active step. PHOTO CAVEAT: the photos in public/imagery/ come from the design system's uploads and include AI-generated reference images — replace them with licensed community photography before publication (brief §6). Never invent figures: leave a field out rather than guessing it.
